paper_metadata.title: Mapping the creep life of nickel-based SX superalloys in a large compositional space by a two-model linkage machine learning method

evidence.quote: a two-model linkage method was developed to predict the creep life of nickel-based single crystal superalloys through a data-driven machine learning approach

evidence.section: 4.3 Studying the synergistic effects of alloying elements by two-model linkage method
evidence.quote: a composition space was constructed by (7–15) Co-(3.5–6)Cr-(1–2.5)Mo-(2.5–4)Ru-6Al-4Re-8Ta-5W-Bal.Ni (wt.%)

evidence.section: 4.1 Reasons of not including microstructural parameters in our model
evidence.quote: the γ’ volume fraction of nickel-based single crystal superalloys after the standard heat treatment was mainly distributed in the range of 62.8 – 69.1%, and the size of the γ’ phase was mainly distributed in the range of 0.32 – 0.45 μ m
the detrimental effect of promoting the precipitation of TCP phases is responsible for the reduced creep life of alloy SC1211
the detrimental effect of promoting the precipitation of TCP phases is responsible for the reduced creep life of alloy SC1121

Although Cr is beneficial to the increase of γ/γ′ lattice misfit absolute value and decrease the average interfacial dislocation spacing, the detrimental effect of promoting the precipitation of TCP phases is responsible for the reduced creep life of alloy SC1211
increasing Ru content can decrease the average interfacial dislocation spacing and suppress the formation of harmful TCP phases, thus improve the creep life of SC1112 compared to SC1111

machine_learning_models.name: back propagation neural network
machine_learning_models.task: Regression prediction of creep life (Model L)
machine_learning_models.dataset: 153 sets of nickel-based SX superalloy creep data collected from literature

evidence.quote: The model constructed by the BPNN algorithm possessed the highest R 2 score of 0.75 and lowest RMSE of 128.78 MPa and was significantly superior to other algorithms. Therefore, BPNN was selected to construct Model L.

machine_learning_models.name: back propagation neural network
machine_learning_models.task: Regression prediction of creep stress (Model σ)
machine_learning_models.dataset: 153 sets of nickel-based SX superalloy creep data collected from literature

evidence.quote: the BPNN algorithm which had the highest R 2 score of 0.96 and lowest RMSE of 12.25 was chosen again to construct Model σ .
